plain.li: [winter] A cold day, and still the best one in a while: they said yes to "{WISH}".
[trait:Ascetic] They gave me what I asked for. I'll try not to ask for more.
[trait:Jealous] Got mine at last. Now the others can watch me enjoy it for a change.
[old] I've asked for things all my life and heard no more often than yes. Today was a yes.
[teen] They actually listened to me. I didn't think they took me seriously.
[hurt] Laid up and sore, and they still went and did it. I didn't expect that.
[newcomer] I've barely been here, and they did what I asked anyway. I'll remember that.
[winter] Still nothing. "{WISH}" can wait with the rest of my hopes until spring.
[trait:Greedy] They found time for everyone's requests but mine. I've made a list.
[old] I've waited on councils before. This one is no faster.
[trait:Greedy] Refused. They'll say yes to someone else soon enough, and I'll be watching.
[trait:Volatile] They said no, and I said some things back. I'm not sorry yet.
[old] At my age you learn to take a no. I still don't like it.
[winter] Fought in the snow. My feet are still numb, but I've got all my toes.
[trait:Wimp] I hid for most of it. I'm not proud. I'm alive.
[trait:Tough] Took a hit and kept going. The others say I should rest. I'll rest tomorrow.
[trait:Nervous] My hands haven't stopped shaking since it ended.
[old] I've seen too many of these. They don't get easier. They just get familiar.
[lowtech] Arrows still stuck in the gate. I pulled them out one by one and kept the good ones.
[!lowtech] The walls are pocked with bullet holes. I counted them on the way to supper.
[newcomer] My first raid here. The others moved like they'd done it before, and I suppose they have.
